description: Offline avatars in the header ("O" Otter, "PR" Priya) are dark grey initials on a near-black disc with no outline; they nearly disappear against the header and read as disabled controls rather than people.
expected: Offline Actors stay legible (initials at 4.5:1, or at least 3:1 for the 32px disc) while still reading as offline.
actual: Initials and disc are very low contrast against the #111-ish header background.
suggested_fix: Raise the offline initials/disc colour and add a thin neutral outline so the presence encoding stays outline-based rather than near-invisible.

description: The viewer appears twice in the header: as "MO" in the People stack and again as the "You: Maya Okafor" button right beside it, each with its own presence ring. With 7 Actors this pushes a teammate behind "+2".
expected: The viewer is shown once (the You button), and the stack is reserved for others.
actual: Maya occupies one of the 5 stack slots and the You button.
suggested_fix: Exclude the viewer from the People stack (keep them in the People dialog).

description: Immediately after opening the board, the viewer's own avatar and You button show Idle (dashed) because only pointerdown/keydown/input count as activity; a person who has just arrived and is reading sees themselves as Idle and so do teammates.
expected: Opening or focusing the page counts as activity, so a just-arrived person is Active.
actual: "Maya Okafor, human, idle" on load until the first click.
suggested_fix: Treat page load / visibility-becomes-visible / focus as an activity signal.

description: The profile repeats state and device: heading "Human · Active" and session row "Active · Browser"; Devices "dev-mbp" under Identity and Device "dev-mbp" in the session. "Expires in 36 s without a report" is protocol detail for a person.
expected: State shown once; device shown once when there is a single device; lease detail hidden or phrased as "last seen".
actual: Repeated state and device; protocol-oriented expiry line.
suggested_fix: Collapse the session row's Device when it equals the only device; replace Expires with "Seen just now".
